decision: so dang ky tap trung (registry.ts) lam nguon duy nhat cua slug va states, thay vi moi proto mot route tinh khong so, hoac tu quet thu muc bang quy uoc
impact: duoc: muc luc, tra slug la, va mot cho duy nhat de cam phep do chan quen-khai-state. Mat: them proto phai sua mot file — doi lai viec do khong lam len duoc

decision: proto o lai vinh vien thanh phong trung bay, khong xoa o S5
impact: duoc: mo lai ban da duyet bat cu luc nao, proto cu thanh vat lieu cho vong sau. Mat: co y nhan rui ro drift — khong dung luoi rieng, dua vao check-types va build vi proto nam trong do thi cua chung. Day cung la ly do ky thuat de bat bac real-components
revisit: khi so proto du lon de build cham thay duoc

decision: co dev la bien moi truong rieng PROTO_ROUTE, khong dung NODE_ENV !== production
impact: duoc: bat duoc tren mot ban trien khai preview de nguoi duyet mo bang dien thoai, va co mot ten that cho host_embed.dev_flag. Mat: mot bien nua phai nuoi trong .env.example, va dev cung phai dat bien moi mo duoc — nen dev_cmd mang san PROTO_ROUTE=1

decision: them /proto vao danh sach ANONYMOUS cua apps/app/proxy.ts de ban bam duoc mo duoc khi khong co cookie phien
impact: co y nhan downside nang nhat cua vong: proxy thoi canh /proto nen co PROTO_ROUTE thanh lop chan DUY NHAT. Doi lai AC-2 do o dung dieu kien khong-cookie (phan biet duoc co-chan voi proxy-chan) va AC-13 do rang danh sach chi dai them dung mot muc. Hai phuong an khac deu te hon: nhet proto duoi /t la sai nghia va dung [site]; them vao UNGATED la vo ich vi UNGATED nam sau lan kiem phien

decision: bo design-pass — vong nay dung chinh duong proto ma design-pass can, nen luc S1 chay thi proto_route chua ton tai; nut moi khong ne duoc bang cach sap xep lai thu tu
impact: Gate 1 duyet UI bang chu — mat khoanh khac visual truoc duyet. Chi ap cho dung vong nay: tu vong sau kho da co proto_route nen khong con co do
revisit: ngay sau khi vong nay ship — vong UI ke tiep phai chay S1-D that

decision: khong khai design_pass.capture_cmd trong vong nay
impact: scripts/ui-capture.mjs la ban tham chieu mot-URL-mot-file, khong khop quy uoc dat ten ma tran <state>--<breakpoint>--<theme>.png cua design-pass. De trong thi design-pass tu chup bang Browser pane, duong no xu ly san; khai mot lenh khong khop quy uoc goi te hon de trong
revisit: khi kho viet bo chup ma tran that — viec rieng, dung scripts/ui-capture.mjs

decision: khong wire executors.design.static trong vong nay
impact: bang CT1 cua feature-loop tro config:executors.design.static; kho chi co .gate va .ui_check nen con tro do dang chet. De ngoai vi no nam o lan static chu khong phai lan proto — keo vao la phong mot vong da du viec
revisit: vong UI ke tiep cham lan static, hoac mot chip rieng

decision: rang HTTP tu dung may chu cua rieng no tren cong roi, KHONG doc APP_URL mac dinh
impact: doi lai moi rang cham hon vi phai cho server len. Duoc: khong do nham cay — mot ban dev dang chay o checkout chinh se bi do thay cho cay dang xet va ket qua van in ra nhu thuong (lop loi da ghi trong CLAUDE.md cua kho)

decision: ba task doc lap chay TUAN TU trong vong chinh, khong fan-out Workflow worktree
impact: lech voi mac dinh cua vong lap (>=2 task independent thi fan-out). Ly do: moi task chi 2 file, chi phi dung worktree va gop nhanh lon hon phan song song tiet kiem; va kho nay da co lop loi ghi lai ve rang chay song song chet vi chi muc git dung chung. Doi lai: mat vai phut so voi truong hop fan-out chay tron
